places: OpenBible.info — CC BY; some coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors — ODbL. Names, alternative identifications and modern coordinates retained. KML point features only; no verse-level location inference.
terrain: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen) sampled and simplified from Terrarium elevation tiles; heights exaggerated in display. Global SRTM/GMTED2010 courtesy of USGS; Global ETOPO1 courtesy of NOAA; Europe terrain produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union (EU-DEM).
land: Natural Earth 1:110m land, public domain; simplified present-day coastlines, not reconstructed ancient shorelines.
